posts.title: Successful Software Rewrites With AI
posts.description: Last year in August I wrote a blog post where I predicted that it should be possible to do rewrite software projects using AI. Here’s an assessment of how much of that came true. The one that made the headlines In the first half of 2026, Anthropic rewrote the entire Bun javascript engine from Zig to Rust. Details are in Jared Sumner’s blog post . posts.title: Thirty Six Hours in SF
posts.description: Last week I did a whirlwind trip of San Francisco. I spent 36 hours there and it was very intense. I want to record what I did and what I felt. This will be my longest blog post ever, but I want to keep it as one post. Because it was one continuous experience for me. posts.title: A Game Building Workshop for Kids and Parents
posts.description: Last Sunday I co-organized a workshop for kids and their parents. The goal was to let Claude Code build games using the Godot Game Engine . It went really well, much better than I had expected. Back story It all began with the Nerdy Parents Club of Cambridge - a very nice community I joined earlier this year.
